items.opportunities: Resorts, boutique hotels, ecolodges, dive tourism services.
items.why: Increasing demand for sustainable and luxury tourism, fueled by Oriental Mindoro’s rich marine biodiversity and pristine island destinations.

items.opportunities: Establishment of Oriental Mindoro IT Park for BPOs, shared service centers, data centers, and startups.
items.why: Rising demand for ICT-enabled services outside Metro Manila; offers a skilled young workforce, lower overhead costs, and government support for ICT infrastructure.

items.opportunities: Development of Oriental Mindoro Transport Stop — a provincial transport terminal and logistics hub integrating bus, van, and cargo operations.
items.why: Enhances connectivity within the province and to Metro Manila; supports trade, tourism mobility, and efficient goods distribution.

items.opportunities: Value-added processing of rice, coconuts (copra, virgin coconut oil), bananas, fish/seafood, cold chain logistics, and agri-supply chains.
items.why: Strong raw-material base and potential to increase farmer incomes through processing, packaging, and exports.

items.opportunities: Seaweed farming, shrimp/prawn culture, marine hatcheries, feed production, and integrated fish farming.
items.why: High demand for sustainable seafood both domestically and internationally, leveraging the Verde Island Passage brand for premium markets.

items.opportunities: Solar farms, wind projects, biomass from agri-waste, and hybrid mini-grids for off-grid barangays.
items.why: Growing local energy needs and national incentives for clean, renewable energy investments.
